technicalBlocker: The likely local government host https://www.haicheng.gov.cn timed out on two ordinary TLS GET attempts (20-second limit each). Search-visible official material provided no map/viewer/API link, and no login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA bypass, or unsafe fields were used.
remainingUncertainty: Haicheng may have an internal or authenticated cadastral system, and the local government host may expose services when reachable. No exact-point hit or absence inference is made from the timeout or lack of search results.
nextStep: Hold runtime integration. A later researcher may qualify an anonymous first-party parcel endpoint only after independently verifying schema, CRS, stable native identity, and safe ID-plus-geometry output.
